manifest.name: dsh-tool-vision
manifest.description: Lightweight vision assist preset and CLI for DeepSeek Harness.

bundle.text:
# Installed as a profile layer by:
#   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-vision

# Installs/updates the packaged vision-assist preset on DSH boot. Vision API
# configuration is owned by the plugin and is not registered as a chat model.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-tool-vision
      name: dsh-tool-vision

readme.text:
dsh-minimal-vision

保持极简模式的上下文边界，同时获得按需视觉能力

中文 · English

🎬 介绍视频：[开源] DSH 极简模式视觉插件 👀 轻量化+干净
> 该视觉插件不是新的聊天模型，也不是第三个常驻工具。它只在需要时，通过隐藏上下文和 Bash 进入 Agent 工作流。

极简模式的优势不只是工具少，更重要的是首轮请求拥有干净、稳定的 system prompt 和工具面。测试中观察到要触发 DS 的灰测行为水平依赖这个起点；额外 system prompt、聊天工具或视觉模型注册都可能改变它。

本插件不改写极简模式的 system prompt，也不注册新的聊天模型。视觉说明、图片路径和文档路径作为一条默认折叠的 context 与用户消息一起进入，原有两个工具保持不变，在尽量保留极简模式行为的同时提供识图能力。

| 设计约束 | 实现方式 | | --- | --- | | 保持原始工具面 | 继续只向模型暴露 persistent-bash 和 str_replace_editor | | 避免污染 system prompt | 用折叠 context 提供附件路径和调用说明 | | 视觉按需触发 | Agent 判断需要视觉证据时，通过 Bash 调用 dsh-vision | | 分离文档处理 | PDF、Word、PPT 的读取、导出、裁剪、拼图和编辑仍由 Agent 完成 |

1. 用户在 vision-assist 模式中拖入图片或文档。 2. 图片由 sharp 自动纠正方向、铺平透明背景，并将长边限制为 1600 px；PDF、DOC、DOCX、PPT、PPTX 原样保存。 3. 插件把本地附件路径放入隐藏 context，用户消息气泡保持干净。 4. Agent 自行判断如何用 Bash 读取或导出文档，并在需要视觉证据时调用视觉模型。 支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF、PDF、DOC、DOCX、PPT 和 PPTX；一次最多处理 4 张图片。“测试连接”只发送最小纯文本请求，不上传附件。Vision 配置独立存在，不会出现在聊天模型列表。 附件在发送时写入 $DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tool-vision/ 本地缓存，隐藏 context 只包含本地路径。文档本身不会直接发送到视觉接口；只有 Agent 调用 dsh-vision 时指定的图片才会发送给已配置的视觉服务。

> ⚠️ **兼容性提示：当前版本暂未适配原生 Windows PowerShell，仅支持 Bash 环境；已在 Ubuntu 和 WSL2 下通过测试。Windows 用户请暂时在 WSL2 内安装并运行 DSH 与本插件，原生 Windows PowerShell 支持即将推出。**

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/Flora233333/dsh-minimal-vision.git
cd dsh-minimal-vision
npm install
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh web
~~~

**启动后选择“视觉辅助模式”，并在“设置 -> Vision”中完成配置。**

| 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | API protocol | OpenAI Completions 或 Gemini | | Base URL | 视觉模型服务商提供的接口地址 | | Model | 视觉模型 ID | | API Key | 由 DSH 凭据服务保存为 VISION_API_KEY | 插件没有写死服务商地址。CLI 每次读取 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 和 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml；环境变量 VISION_API_KEY 优先级更高。

~~~bash "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/bin/dsh-vision" \ analyze --task custom --instructions "描述图中可见内容" -- /path/to/image.png ~~~ 内置任务：custom、slide_review、figure_semantics、caption_grounding、flowchart_extract。PPT/PPTX/PDF 需要先由 Agent 导出为图片。
~~~bash npm install npm run check npm test ~~~ 请勿提交 node_modules/、.playwright-cli/、.env 或任何 DSH 凭据文件。

dsh-minimal-vision

Preserve minimal mode's context boundary while adding vision on demand

中文 · English

🎬 Introduction video: Open-source DSH Minimal Mode Vision Plugin 👀 Lightweight + Clean
> Vision is not a new chat model or a third resident tool. It enters the Agent workflow only when needed, through hidden context and Bash.

Minimal mode is valuable not only because it has fewer tools, but because the first request starts with a clean, stable system prompt and tool surface. The DS behavior observed in gray testing depends on that starting point; extra system prompts, chat tools, or a registered vision model can change it.

This plugin does not rewrite minimal mode's system prompt or register a vision provider as a chat model. Vision instructions, image paths, and document paths arrive as one collapsed context message alongside the user request. The original two tools remain unchanged, providing image understanding while preserving minimal-mode behavior as far as possible.

| Constraint | Implementation | | --- | --- | | Preserve the original tool surface | Only persistent-bash and str_replace_editor remain exposed to the model | | Keep the system prompt clean | Attachment paths and usage instructions live in collapsed context | | Invoke vision on demand | The Agent calls dsh-vision through Bash only when visual evidence is needed | | Keep document work separate | PDF, Word, and PowerPoint reading, export, cropping, stitching, and editing remain Agent tasks |

1. The user drops an image or document in vision-assist mode. 2. sharp normalizes images and caps the long edge at 1600 px; PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, and PPTX files are stored unchanged. 3. The plugin places local attachment paths in hidden context, keeping the user message bubble clean. 4. The Agent decides how to inspect or export documents with Bash and calls the vision model only when visual evidence is useful.

PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, and PPTX are supported, with up to four images per request. “Test connection” sends only a minimal text request and never uploads an attachment. Vision settings stay separate from the chat model list.

Attachments are written to the local $DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tool-vision/ cache when sent, while hidden context contains only local paths. Documents are never sent directly to the vision endpoint; only images explicitly passed to dsh-vision by the Agent are sent to the configured vision service.

> ⚠️ **Compatibility notice: Native Windows PowerShell is not supported yet. The current version requires a Bash environment and has been tested on Ubuntu and WSL2. Windows users should install and run DSH and this plugin inside WSL2 for now. Native Windows PowerShell support is coming soon.**

~~~bash
git clone https://github.com/Flora233333/dsh-minimal-vision.git
cd dsh-minimal-vision
npm install
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh web
~~~
Select “Vision Assist” after startup, then configure the provider under “Settings -> Vision”.

| Field | Description | | --- | --- | | API protocol | OpenAI Completions or Gemini | | Base URL | The endpoint supplied by the vision provider | | Model | The provider's vision model ID | | API key | Stored by DSH as VISION_API_KEY | No provider endpoint is hard-coded. The CLI reads $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml and $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml on every call; the VISION_API_KEY environment variable takes precedence.

~~~bash "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/bin/dsh-vision" \ analyze --task custom --instructions "Describe the visible content" -- /path/to/image.png ~~~ Built-in tasks: custom, slide_review, figure_semantics, caption_grounding, and flowchart_extract. Export PPT/PPTX/PDF pages to images before calling the CLI.
~~~bash npm install npm run check npm test ~~~ Do not commit node_modules/, .playwright-cli/, .env, or DSH credential files.
